name: Mok'thardin's Enchantment
summary: Far Seer Mok'thardin requires one final sacred component to complete the enchantment of a ceremonial choker at Grom'gol Base Camp. He directs you to an elevated Holy Spring along the southern bluffs near the western sea, which has drawn the attention of a hostile naga expedition.

sections.title: A Contested Spring
sections.body: Following the earlier stages of Mok'thardin's enchantment, the far seer seeks water from a Holy Spring situated high above the bluffs in the southern reaches of Stranglethorn Vale, near the western coast. The site is a point of contention among scholars of the mystic and divine, with every race across Azeroth claiming the holy waters were sanctified specifically for their own people.

sections.title: The Naga Incursion
sections.body: A party of naga explorers has moved up to the spring and must be dealt with as well. Mok'thardin requires ten of these serpent intruders slain alongside a draught of the spring water to finish preparing the ceremonial choker in the name of the Warchief.

faq.q: Where is the Holy Spring located?
faq.answer: The Holy Spring sits high atop the bluffs toward the western coast in the southern region of Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: Why is the Holy Spring considered important?
faq.answer: Religious and mystical scholars argue fiercely over the spring, as every race across Azeroth maintains that its divine waters were sanctified especially for them.

faq.q: Who is contesting the Holy Spring?
faq.answer: An expedition of naga explorers has advanced onto the bluffs surrounding the Holy Spring, menacing the area.

faq.q: What is the water being used for?
faq.answer: The water serves as the final reagent required by Far Seer Mok'thardin to prepare and enchant a ceremonial choker in defense of the Horde.

angles.text: Far Seer Mok'thardin asks Horde champions to help finish a ceremonial choker meant to honor the Warchief and protect the Horde.
